title: Staff
description: Who works in this warehouse, with which role and at which sites.
colleagues_description: Everyone in your company sees all its bookings. Admins also manage colleagues.
invite_description: They get an email with a link to join. The link works for 7 days.
sites_hint: Leave all unchecked for every site.
remove_description: They lose access to this organisation with their next click. You can invite them again later.
